description: This source file defines the DbTestAppFactory class, which sets up a test environment for the DataAssetBackend application's database. It spins up an ephemeral PostgreSQL container, applies SQL migrations, and provides methods to create authenticated HTTP clients for testing purposes. The class also manages lifecycle events such as initialization and disposal, and handles configuration overrides for testing.

classes.name: DbTestAppFactory
classes.description: A factory class for setting up an in-memory, database-backed test host for the DataAssetBackend application, with methods for initializing a PostgreSQL container, applying migrations, and creating authenticated HTTP clients.

methods.name: CreateAuthedClient
methods.description: Creates an HttpClient pre-configured with authorization headers and correlation ID for testing.

methods.name: ConfigureWebHost
methods.description: Overrides the web host configuration for testing environment, setting environment variables and replacing certain services.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Starts the PostgreSQL container, applies database migrations, and obtains a test JWT token.

methods.name: ApplyMigrationsAsync
methods.description: Reads SQL migration files and executes them sequentially against the database.
